official.deadline_note: Alberta Student Aid publishes no application deadline for this scholarship; it directs applicants to the Student Awards or Scholarships Offices at their school, so the effective deadline is each institution's internal awards deadline.
official.application_cycle: Current criteria reference enrolment in the Fall 2026 and/or Winter 2027 terms
official.status_note: The Alberta Student Aid page publishes the current competition criteria, which reference enrolment in at least one term in the Fall 2026 and/or Winter 2027 terms; Alberta Student Aid itself runs no application intake.
benefits: Minimum award of $11,000 and maximum of $15,000
Funded through the Alberta Heritage Scholarship Fund
Open to international students as well as Canadian citizens, Permanent Residents and Protected Persons, and Status Indian/First Nations, Non-Status Indian/First Nations, Metis or Inuit applicants
eligibility: Enrolled full-time in a master's, doctoral or graduate level program; graduate level programs must be able to ladder into a master's degree program
Enrolled in at least 60% of a full course load (40% for students with a disability) in at least one term of study in a graduate program
Enrolled in the Fall 2026 and/or Winter 2027 term
Living in Alberta while studying at an eligible Alberta post-secondary institution
Canadian citizen, Permanent Resident of Canada or Protected Person; OR international student; OR Status Indian/First Nations, Non-Status Indian/First Nations, Metis or Inuit
requirements: Schools select recipients based on the minimum eligibility criteria for the Alberta Graduate Excellence Scholarship and any additional eligibility criteria set by the school
For more information on how to apply, contact the Student Awards or Scholarships Offices at your school, or visit your school's website
selection_criteria: Selection is carried out by the school, based on the minimum AGES eligibility criteria plus any additional criteria the school sets
coverage: Minimum award of $11,000 and maximum of $15,000, funded through the Alberta Heritage Scholarship Fund; the page publishes no statement of what the award covers
application_method: Contact the Student Awards or Scholarships Office at your school, or visit your school's website, for information on how to apply
official.application_route: You do not apply to Alberta Student Aid; your school selects recipients, so the route runs through your institution's awards office and its internal deadline.
official.study_mode: Full-time graduate enrolment (at least 60% of a full course load; 40% for students with a disability)
official.citizenship_residency: Canadian citizen, Permanent Resident or Protected Person; international student; or Status Indian/First Nations, Non-Status Indian/First Nations, Metis or Inuit. Applicants must be living in Alberta while studying.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - international students are an explicit target group; the scholarship was established to attract the best and brightest students, including international students, to study in Alberta
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Master's, doctoral or graduate level programs that can ladder into a master's degree program at an eligible Alberta post-secondary institution; no field restriction published
official.description: The Alberta Graduate Excellence Scholarship recognizes outstanding academic achievement of students pursuing graduate studies in Alberta. It was established to attract the best and brightest students, including international students, to study in Alberta, and is funded through the Alberta Heritage Scholarship Fund. Schools select recipients based on the minimum eligibility criteria and any additional criteria set by the school.
official.program_type: Provincial scholarship administered by Alberta Student Aid

applicant_utility.summary: There is no central application for the AGES: Alberta Student Aid publishes no deadline and no form because each eligible Alberta institution runs its own internal awards process and nominates its own recipients, so your real deadline is your school's. Aim to be in your faculty awards office in September or early October, before internal faculty deadlines, and be enrolled at a 60% course load (40% with a disability) in a program that can ladder into a master's degree. The published range of CAD 11,000 to 15,000 means your school's own criteria decide where in that band you land.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving full-time master's and doctoral students at an eligible Alberta institution, including international students, who are living in Alberta and can secure their school's nomination before its internal deadline.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your program is a master's, doctoral or graduate level program that can ladder into a master's degree program
Confirm you will be enrolled in at least 60% of a full course load (40% with a disability) in Fall 2026 and/or Winter 2027
Confirm you are living in Alberta while studying at an eligible Alberta post-secondary institution
Contact your school's Student Awards or Scholarships Office early for its internal nomination deadline and required forms
common_rejection_risks: Waiting for an Alberta Student Aid application window that does not exist and missing your school's internal deadline
Enrolling below the 60% course-load threshold (or 40% for students with a disability) in the qualifying term
Being in a graduate-level program that cannot ladder into a master's degree program
Not being physically resident in Alberta while studying
Assuming the same award can be held more than once in a year - only one AGES per student per year is the norm applied by institutions
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The AGES is a cash recognition award of CAD 11,000-15,000; the official page publishes no tuition, living-cost or travel component, so tuition, rent, food and travel remain the student's own responsibility.
document_audit: Alberta Student Aid publishes no document list for this award - your institution's awards office defines the required forms, so ask them directly rather than relying on aggregator checklists
Because selection is school-based, your transcript and standing with your faculty carry the assessment; keep an up-to-date transcript on file with your department
alerts: The award is selected by schools against minimum provincial criteria plus school-specific criteria, so two equally strong students at different Alberta universities face different bars
The current criteria are written around the Fall 2026 and/or Winter 2027 terms - if your enrollment term differs, confirm eligibility with your school before assuming you qualify
International students are eligible, but you must hold status that lets you live and study in Alberta
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: No direct submission exists: you approach your school's Student Awards or Scholarships Office, the school applies its internal process and additional criteria, and recipients are notified by the institution.
